title: 経営情報専門実験・演習B
subtitle: Management Systems Major Lab/Exercises B
keywords: Strategy Planning 2.Social data analysis 3.Open data 4.Programming for Embedded Systems
educationalGoal: This practicum in applied business management is a compulsory course for third-year students. In this course, students will: (1) Use the case method to develop the analytical and planning skills needed to formulate a business strategy. (2) Exploring issues for regional revitalization based on open data analysis. (3) Implement their ideas and exercise their programming skills using Arduino.
advice: This compulsory course uses the following: 1) Strategy planning in which students will review and analyze the strategies of ‘real’ companies and develop new strategies for these companies. (group activity) Students will be required to create documents such as a strategic analysis report and devise a new strategic plan. 2Students will develop the ability to grasp problems faced in society structurally and propose logical solutions based on objective evidence by extracting and organizing social issues through basic analysis of social survey data, field surveys, literature research, etc., and repeatedly formulating and verifying hypotheses. 3) Programming for an original system using Arduino. (individual activity) Students will be required to implement their ideas via Arduino and give a presentation describing the implementation.
books: Make:Getting Started with Arduino 3rd Edition(Publisher:Make Community)
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of management Basic computer skills

achievementLevels.ideal: 1) Review and analyze the strategy of a ‘real’ company based on published information such as financial reports, and formulate a creative strategy for the company. 2)Through multivariate analysis of various surveys and open data, Students can structurally clarify issues by repeatedly setting and verifying hypotheses, and propose essential and effective solutions. 3) Produce a work of creative programming using Arduino based on original ideas.
achievementLevels.standard: 1) Review and analyze the strategy of a ‘real’ company based on news releases, and formulate a strategy for the company. 2) Process open data appropriately and verify hypotheses using basic statistical methods, and logically explain the background to social issues and propose feasible and reasonable solutions. 3) Create a programming work using Arduino.
